subject: Acme - pricing & token volume confirmation
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Alex Moore <alex.moore@acme.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-02T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Acme - pricing & token volume confirmation

Hi Alex,

Thanks again for the call earlier – quick recap and next steps below. Appreciate you walking us through the support agent workloads.

Call recap
- Workload: customer support assistant (chat). Average sequence length observed during demo: ~450 tokens (prompt+completion split variable).
- Expected monthly volume (your estimate): 150M prompt tokens / 300M completion tokens (~450M total tokens/month).
- Peak concurrency: ~120 concurrent active users (estimated).
- Requirement: predictable latency (targeting 99.9th percentile SLO), and a target cost envelope for budgeting.

Pricing & unit economics assumptions used in the attached model
- Model: RedM-3B (quantized variant for production)
- Baseline unit: $2,100 per 1M tokens (this is our uncommitted hosted list – see cost model for breakdown).
- Expected operational reductions: batching + prefix caching expected to reduce effective per-token cost by ~15% for this workload profile.
- If Acme wants a committed/dedicated arrangement, we can provide tiered pricing (examples in sheet).

Attachments included: Acme_pricing_estimate_v3.xlsx (detailed cost model & invoice estimate), pricing_calculator.csv (raw inputs).

Action items / questions
1) Can you confirm the 450M total tokens/month is the steady-state run-rate (or is it just initial month)?
2) What is Acme's target $/1M tokens budget threshold (e.g., <$2k / $1M tokens would push us to propose a commit)?
3) Are there any security/compliance constraints that would require Redwood Private (VPC/on-prem) vs Hosted?

Next steps
- Please reply with confirmed token volumes and a budget range by EOD Wednesday (May 5).
- If confirmed, we’ll produce a formal invoice estimate and a committed pricing proposal for dedicated capacity.

Thanks,

Sean Gallagher
Principal Sales Engineer
Redwood Inference

--
Attachment(s): Acme_pricing_estimate_v3.xlsx (spreadsheet), pricing_calculator.csv (csv)

From: Alex Moore <alex.moore@acme.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@acme.com>
Date: 2027-05-03T09:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Acme - pricing & token volume confirmation

Sean – thanks for the recap and the files. A few clarifications from our side: 

- The 450M tokens/month is our expected steady-state for the primary support assistant (we expect growth but plan for this baseline).
- Split: prompt/completion split you used is accurate for now (we’ll keep monitoring).
- Budget: leadership is targeting ~ $1,800 per 1M tokens as the target unit economics to meet our internal ROI thresholds. If we can get to ~ $1.8k with a predictable SLA, that’s attractive.
- Security: Hosted is fine for now, but we’ll need to evaluate data retention and audit logs (we might ask for Private for the next phase).

Can you re-run the estimate with the $1.8k target and include a 12-month commit scenario (and show the delta to hosted list pricing)? Also include a simple invoice that maps to our fiscal quarters.

Thanks – Alex
Alex Moore
Head of Product Ops
Acme Corp

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-03T12:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Acme - pricing & token volume confirmation

Alex – great, thanks for the budget target and steady-state confirmation. I re-ran the model attaching an updated invoice estimate and a 12-month commit scenario. Highlights: 

- Baseline hosted list (no commit): $2,100 / 1M tokens (same as before).
- Effective hosted (with caching/operational gains we expect for your workload): ~$1,785 / 1M tokens (15% reduction).
- 12-month committed pricing (proposed): $1,650 / 1M tokens
  - Commit scenario assumes 12-month MOQs at your 450M tokens/month steady-state.
  - This includes a standard SLA (99.9), weekly cost/loss reporting, and access to cost-optimization recommendations from Redwood Optimize.

Attached: Acme_pricing_estimate_v3.xlsx (updated tab "12mo-commit"), acme_unit_economics_summary.pdf (one-pager), pricing_calculator.csv (updated inputs).

Next steps proposed:
- If $1,650 / 1M tokens on a 12-month commit looks reasonable, we can loop in Contracts to produce a clean MA and draft MSA with those economics. Marissa, can you start a draft?
- Alex/Priya: please confirm whether procurement needs any additional documents (e.g., SOC 2 report, data processing addendum). We’ll include links in the renewal packet.

I’ll also add a simple quarter-by-quarter invoice estimate for finance to review.

Thanks,
Sean

--
Attachment(s): Acme_pricing_estimate_v3.xlsx (updated), acme_unit_economics_summary.pdf, pricing_calculator.csv

Thanks Sean – received the updated estimate. Priya here from procurement. A couple quick asks: 

1) Please add a simple invoice summary broken out by quarter (Q3 start) so we can route to finance.
2) Include SOC 2 Type II and Data Processing Addendum links in the packet – we’ll need those for our security review.
3) We are amenable to a 12-month commit at $1,650 / 1M tokens, but procurement will need final MA + MSA before finance signs off.

If you can get the quarter-by-quarter invoice and the SOC 2/DPAs attached, we’ll start internal approvals this week.

Thanks – Priya
